evidence_quotes: PARCELAMENTO IRREGULAR DO SOLO E LOTEAMENTO CLANDESTINO - DANOS URBANÍSTICOS E AMBIENTAIS.
O TJ decidiu que tanto os particulares quanto o município são responsáveis pelos danos causados por conta do loteamento irregular.
rationale: The decision summary addresses joint civil liability of private subdividers/heirs and the municipality for generic urban and environmental damages resulting from irregular land parceling and a clandestine subdivision (parcelamento irregular do solo e loteamento clandestino) due to negligent municipal land-use inspection. Across all summary fields, there is no reference to water resources, watershed protection zones (áreas de proteção de mananciais), water bodies, or household water/sanitation service access or infrastructure. Accordingly, it is classified as NOT_WATER and not_water_related, with medium confidence given the broad phrase 'danos urbanísticos e ambientais' in the summary abstract.
